zh: 峰会提词器支持后台推进、逐句高亮和中英文自然旁白。演示屏可独立选择中文、英文或阿拉伯语，并跟随主讲人翻页。
主讲人可分享限时免登录展示链接。隐藏公司标识时，三语封面和中英文讲解同步切换到《AI 落地的最后一公里》，并从当前句继续。英文开场使用 Dragon 署名。
峰会旁白和背景音乐由独立媒体仓库分发，播放器按需加载并校验音频。
改进智能体会话并发与移动端审批处理，并更新工具来源展示和内置工具目录。
en: The summit teleprompter can advance in the background with synchronized highlights and natural Mandarin or English narration. Each screen can follow in Chinese, English or Arabic.

Presenters can share time-limited guest links. Hiding company branding switches the cover and narration to The Last Mile of AI and continues from the current sentence. The English introduction uses Dragon.
Summit narration and background music are distributed through the separate media repository with on-demand loading and integrity checks.
Improved agent session concurrency and mobile approval handling, and updated tool source indicators and the built-in catalog.
